name: freetier_public_deploy
summary: Production deploy bundle for the two public-facing servers (freetier_callback :8540 and model_api :8521) plus the Caddy reverse-proxy fragment that fronts them with TLS on trollz.fun and GentlyOS.io. Both Python servers bind only on 127.0.0.1; Caddy is the sole public surface. Ships to DO droplet 159.89.181.146 via rsync+ssh, installed at /opt/mspc-public/ under unprivileged user 'mspc'. Idempotent — re-running upgrades in place. Reuses the pattern established by studio/mcp/replit-bridge/deploy-to-droplet.sh.
engine_pattern: Two systemd units (mspc-callback.service, mspc-model-api.service) + one Caddyfile fragment installed into /etc/caddy/Caddyfile.d/. deploy.sh DEFAULTS to DRY_RUN=1; real deploy requires explicit DRY_RUN=0 ./deploy.sh. Pre-flight verifies all source paths exist and .env present on laptop before any rsync runs.

components.Caddyfile.droplet: Reverse-proxy fragment. Two server blocks: trollz.fun (+ www) and GentlyOS.io (+ www). Both auto-acquire TLS via Let's Encrypt. trollz.fun routes /terms* and /terms/policies/callback* to :8540 and /v1/* to :8521; GentlyOS.io routes /endpoint/freetier/* to :8540 and /v1/* to :8521. Sets X-Forwarded-For/-Proto/-Host/-Real-IP via a shared (forwarded) snippet. Catch-all on trollz.fun redirects / -> /terms/; GentlyOS.io returns a friendly dev-front 404.
components.mspc-callback.service: Runs python3 /opt/mspc-public/freetier_callback/server.py --port 8540 --bind 127.0.0.1 as user mspc:mspc. Loads .env via EnvironmentFile. PYTHONPATH includes both /opt/mspc-public and /opt/mspc-public/lib so the server's `sys.path.insert(.., core/lib)` resolves to lib/. Hardened: NoNewPrivileges, PrivateTmp, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome, narrow ReadWritePaths.
components.mspc-model-api.service: Runs python3 /opt/mspc-public/lib/model_api.py serve --port 8521 --bind 127.0.0.1. Ordered After=mspc-callback.service so the token-issuing callback is up first. Same hardening as the callback unit.
components.deploy.sh: Bash script run from laptop. Resolves repo root via SCRIPT_DIR (deploy/freetier_public/ is 3 up). Verifies seven required source paths + .env exist locally. Rsyncs: studio/endpoints/freetier_callback/ -> /opt/mspc-public/freetier_callback/, core/lib/ -> /opt/mspc-public/lib/, studio/auth/ (minus keys.sqlite + .master_secret + freetier_acceptances.sqlite, since the registry is host-scoped) -> /opt/mspc-public/auth/, studio/assets/_agents/agent_defs/ -> /opt/mspc-public/agent_defs/, .env (mode 600) -> /opt/mspc-public/.env, then unit files + Caddyfile. On DRY_RUN=0: creates 'mspc' user, installs unit files into /etc/systemd/system/, daemon-reload + enable + restart, installs Caddyfile fragment + validates + reloads caddy, smoke-tests both /healthz endpoints via loopback. Uses BatchMode SSH + StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new + ConnectTimeout=8.
components.README.md: Full operator docs: what gets deployed, prerequisites (DNS A records for both domains, .env present, Caddy installed, SSH key, firewall :80/:443 open), how to deploy, cert acquisition flow, post-deploy curl smoke tests, journalctl tails, and rollback (systemctl stop, restore /opt/mspc-public/.prev, or DO snapshot rollback).

user_prerequisites_before_deploy: DNS A records for trollz.fun, www.trollz.fun, GentlyOS.io, www.GentlyOS.io all point at 159.89.181.146
.env present at /data/Projects/MySpace++/.env (mirrored with /data/Projects/gently/.env) — contains claude_guest, client_api, pintrest_api, SUI_WALLET + provider keys (deepseek, HF router)
Caddy installed on droplet (apt-get install caddy) — deploy continues with warning if missing but public surface is unreachable without it
SSH key authorizes root@159.89.181.146 — auto-detected (~/.ssh/id_ed25519) or override SSH_KEY=...
Firewall (DO cloud firewall + ufw) allows :80 and :443; does NOT expose :8521 or :8540
substrate: studio/deploy/freetier_public/ (this dir) — five files, ~600 lines total. Drop-in addition; touches no existing code.

inbound_callers: Tom runs deploy.sh manually from laptop after DNS + .env are in place
External HTTPS clients hit trollz.fun + GentlyOS.io after deploy
outbound_calls: curl loopback smoke tests on droplet
routing_connections.substrate_writes: none locally; on droplet creates /opt/mspc-public/ tree + systemd units + caddy fragment

guarantees: DRY_RUN=1 by default — accidental invocation never modifies droplet state
Pre-flight aborts before any rsync if source paths or .env are missing
Both Python servers bind 127.0.0.1 only — never publicly exposed
mspc runs as unprivileged system user, never root
.env mode 600 owned by mspc:mspc on droplet
keys.sqlite excluded from rsync — registry stays host-scoped per salted-token rule
Idempotent — re-running upgrades in place (systemctl restart, caddy reload)
Does not modify existing replit-bridge files (reuse-as-pattern only)
Does not touch core/cc.sh or .env in the repo
usage_example:
cd studio/deploy/freetier_public/
# Dry-run (default):
./deploy.sh
# Real deploy after DNS + .env in place:
DRY_RUN=0 ./deploy.sh
# Verify:
curl https://trollz.fun/terms/
curl https://GentlyOS.io/endpoint/freetier/terms/
what_user_must_do_before_first_real_depl: 1. Confirm DNS A records resolve: dig +short trollz.fun GentlyOS.io  (both must return 159.89.181.146)
3. SSH to droplet once, install caddy if missing: ssh root@159.89.181.146 'apt-get install -y caddy'
4. Run dry-run: cd studio/deploy/freetier_public && ./deploy.sh  (reads pre-flight output)
rollback: ssh root@159.89.181.146 'systemctl stop mspc-callback mspc-model-api'  +  restore /opt/mspc-public/ from snapshot, or DO snapshot rollback. Caddy keeps running with upstream errors until services back up.
phase: production hand-off bundle for public freetier surface (post lively-enchanting-parrot D.7)
